title: TKVM Weapons

Better combat and Epic Fight compatibility included!

# Overview
This mod intends to add a variety of weapons depicted from games like chivalry, mordhau in a vanilla/vanilla+ style. More in line with semi-realistic Medieval European weaponry, with some artistic license. 

Currently, 17 weapons are added. From wooden to starite (New tier), there are a total of 112 variations of weapons to play with.

More weapons are intended for future updates, please don't hesitate to drop a suggestion in the [Discord](https://discord.gg/tYMj9rTnCx)


## Weapons:

![Weapons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/PYDfuJNe/images/3b282b75f0f7f734106b9f2570a1ac11abb7e252.png)

## Starite Tier 
This mod also adds a new item tier for its weapons **STARITE**. 

This is intended to be a end-game upgrade to your netherite weaponry, and gives more purpose to a netherstar other than a beacon. 

You can upgrade netherite weapons using the new smithing template and a nether star. (Heavily recommend to use alongside [TKVM Wither](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/tkvm-wither) to make nether stars harder to farm.

## Crafting

I suggest using [EMI](https://modrinth.com/mod/emi) or [JEI](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei) to view crafting recipes. 

Handle, pole and leather strips are items added to help prevent recipe overlaps from other mods.
